question: What do you do when two things need your attention at the same time?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: “Well, sometimes I turn to the second thing and leave the first half done—that’s where I lose my place. If my housemate’s there, I’ll ask them to remind me what’s still waiting. It helps to finish one thing first, though I don’t always notice I’ve switched until I’m looking for something else. Like the bus card—the bibs were ready, but I’d stopped thinking about picking them up.”
